decisions.series: One series 1-529, one base completion checklist.
decisions.trueRookies: Only the 10 card numbers verified in TCDB rookie index receive RC on Base.
decisions.gold: Distinct 529-card Gold checklist. Gold #525-528 are different players replacing four Base checklists. NEVER derive Gold from Base.
decisions.goldOdds: 1 Gold card per ordinary wax pack; 1:1 ProductSet odds.
decisions.factoryOnly: Historical Base and Gold #529 Eric Lindros were factory-set-only. VCS intentionally makes both eligible in ordinary packs as a documented gameplay exception so the full 529-card checklists can be completed through pack ripping, with equal within-set odds.
decisions.subsets: Clean UER and other notes from player names. Keep printed subset abbreviations as subset metadata.
decisions.packs: VCS four cards per pack, 24 packs per box. Original standard physical pack held 14 base plus one Gold.
decisions.release: Unreleased pending checklist generation and QA, images, pricing and pack artwork. #529 is explicitly pack-eligible; no factory-only exclusion needed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 529 complete Base cards. Historical factory-only #529 is intentionally eligible for ordinary VCS pack draws at equal Base odds.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: 1 Gold per wax pack; actual separate checklist, with replacement players at #525–528. Historical factory-only #529 is deliberately eligible at equal Gold odds.
